name: assessing Codex Node demand
from: Demand Codex Node took up from the work board (a request it promised or a report it adopted), held unassessed in its own root.
to: The demand is either Codex Node's own work, admitted under the taken subject as items its own offices bear duties for, with any part it does not do posted back on the board; or it is given back (released or declined) with the reason it is not Codex Node's work.
cost: Bounded assessment attention of Codex Node's lead on the host's execution capacity; no financial, credential or external commitment.
otherwise: Demand about the Codex execution service and its codex-task queue stays open on the board, at home with the micro-enterprise seated over the enclosing section or, where none is, owed to the market; nobody else holds Codex Node's work.
